family.family_label: Svelte SVG pointer with an ARIA role on the circle

artifacts.content:
<svg
    on:mousemove={(e) => {
        coords.set({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
    }}
    on:mousedown={() => size.set(30)}
    on:mouseup={() => size.set(10)}
>
    <circle
        cx={$coords.x}
        cy={$coords.y}
        r={$size}
        role="button" <!-- or "link", "image", or an appropriate role -->
    />
</svg>

Context.normalized_text: A Svelte SVG acts as a pointer and handles mouse movement and button events; mouse movement updates `coords`, mouse down sets `size` to 30, and mouse up sets `size` to 10.
evidence_spans: What is the correct aria-role for this svg which acts as a pointer?
